concepts.name: SmolVLA
concepts.summary: A flow-matching VLA with the same objective as π0 and a different conditioning design: 0.45B parameters in total against π0's 3.3B, with an action expert of about 100M against 300M. Its backbone is SmolVLM-2 (SigLIP plus SmolLM2) run with LAYER SKIPPING — features are taken at layer N = L/2 and the upper half of the stack never runs. The expert is a SEPARATE transformer stack that reads VLM features from outside, alternating cross-attention layers (actions attend to VLM features) with causal self-attention layers (actions attend to each other). The paper ablates the interleaving as load-bearing.

concepts.name: Which side of the bridge the state sits on
concepts.summary: π0 and SmolVLA place proprioception on opposite sides of the VLM/action boundary. SmolVLA projects the state to one token with a linear layer and concatenates it into the VLM PREFIX alongside image and text, so every feature the expert later reads is already state-aware — perception itself is posture-conditioned. π0 keeps the state on the ACTION EXPERT side, concatenated with the noisy chunk, where it meets vision only through the joint self-attention. The design question underneath is whether posture should inform how the scene is perceived or only how it is acted on; moving the state token when porting code changes the model's information flow, not just its plumbing.
